notes: The native v4 driver and jdspctl hashes are unchanged from the compiler artifact and the earlier successful Pixel global-control probe.
The root app uses the matching vendor-native helper for enable, post-gain and FIR controls, retaining framework attachment and legacy fallback.
Global readiness requires a real protocol-3 probe with one writable context; an AudioFlinger effect alone is not native-control evidence.
The beta-4 APK adds one explicit Retry recovery attempt using the same verified HAL target map as the module; this feature still requires device validation.
